claimText:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` Streetcar frame so source materials are split into dedicated routed surfaces.

Goal:
- Keep the existing ELA 30-1 / Streetcar lesson frame and lesson-page routing.
- Keep Resources for external non-video source cards using the ELA style.
- Add a Library route for local PDFs/documents from the Brightspace export.
- Add a Film Room route for all normalized embedded videos from the imported lessons.
- Regenerate the `ela30-1-modern-drama` workspace/meta output from the newer ELA 30-1 Brightspace export.

Acceptance boundary:
- Edit the ELA generator, focused generator test, and regenerated `ela30-1-modern-drama` project files only.
- Do not wire in other ELA units right now.
- Do not hand-edit raw Brightspace source files except through regeneration.

STAX acknowledgement:
STAX_ACK turn_2026-06-08T14-40-58-754Z_ee23 ff6f987d f859827e

Objective:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` Streetcar frame so external links, local PDFs/documents, and embedded videos are separated into Resources, Library, and Film Room routes.

Files changed:
- `.stax/codex-report.md`
- `.stax/task.md`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/import-log.md`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/project.json`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/reference-index.json`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/resource-catalog.json`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/section-map.json`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/meta/style-guide.md`
- `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html`
- `scripts/lib/ela-modern-drama.ts`
- `scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts`

Tests added:
- Added a regression proving `buildWorkspaceHtml` registers `library` and `film-room` routes, puts PDFs in Library, puts videos in Film Room, and keeps Resources limited to external non-video cards.

Commands run:
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 1 first, expected red failure because the old frame had no Library route.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 0 after implementation.
- `npx tsx scripts/build-ela-modern-drama.ts --zip "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Downloads\D2LExport_6670_CBE System ELA 30-1 (Winter 2020)_20266815.zip" --slug ela30-1-modern-drama --force` - exit 0.
- Generated HTML structural check for Library/Film Room/Resources split - exit 0.
- `npm run verify -- --project ela30-1-modern-drama --mode workspace` - exit 0.
- `npm run typecheck` - exit 0.
- `npm run build:studio` - exit 0.
- Playwright local preview route/mobile check against `http://127.0.0.1:5174/preview/workspace/ela30-1-modern-drama/index.html` - exit 0.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- Focused test now passes: 6 tests, 0 failures.
- Generator rebuilt `ela30-1-modern-drama` with 25 Streetcar lessons.
- Structural check confirmed the Library has the local questions PDF, Film Room has 5 embedded videos, Resources has external cards, and Resources contains no PDF or video iframe/embed content.
- Project verifier passed metadata policy and reported no missing local assets, no missing workspace embeds, and no missing course-shell resources. It reported expected external dependency warnings for Tailwind CDN and Google fonts/icons.
- Typecheck passed with `tsc --noEmit`.
- Studio production build passed.
- Playwright confirmed Library, Film Room, and Resources routes; verified film playlist switching; and found no mobile horizontal overflow on Library, Film Room, or Resources.

What is verified:
- `#library` is a dedicated PDF Library route with the local `A-Streetcar-Named-Desire-questions.pdf` viewer and PDF actions.
- `#film-room` is a dedicated Film Room route with all 5 normalized embedded videos and playlist switching.
- `#resources` renders external non-video sources as ELA-styled resource cards with `Open Resource` actions.
- `#resources` does not include the local PDF or video iframe/embed content.
- Sidebar navigation and static route registration include `library` and `film-room`.
- The generated section map declares `library`, `film-room`, and external-only `resources` roles.

What is weak/provisional:
- STAX visual collection and observer preflight have not been run yet for this refinement.
- The PDF iframe may need Brightspace-specific file mapping during final export/import.
- Tailwind, Google fonts, Material Symbols, external source links, and embedded YouTube videos remain network-dependent.

What is unverified:
- No Brightspace import/export package was produced in this pass.
- No project E2E contract exists for this slug, so verification used focused tests plus a direct Playwright browser route check.
- No gradebook persistence exists; lesson completion remains local preview state.

Risks:
- Future ELA unit swaps may need a configurable unit selector and generalized route split instead of the current Streetcar-first generator target.
- Some external source links from the D2L export may require teacher review before publishing.
- Brightspace may handle local PDF iframe/download behavior differently than the local preview server.

One next action:
Run STAX visual collection and observer preflight, then commit and push the scoped refinement.
